{"consolidated_memory":"## Infinite Recursion Issues in graph/traversal/walker.rs (Graph Engine)

A series of six separate infinite recursion incidents occurred in the walker component of the graph engine, all triggering stack growth until guard protection. Each had a distinct trigger condition and root cause, requiring independent fixes.

### Occurrence 1: [2026-01-07]
- **Trigger**: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- **Repro**: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Root cause**: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Signal**: Stack grows until guard trips
- **Fix**: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR**: #1517, branch fix/infinite-recursion-1
- **Outcome**: Backlog cleared 70 minutes after deploy

### Occurrence 2: [2026-01-18]
- **Trigger**: Clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- **Repro**: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Root cause**: Listener registered but never removed on teardown
- **Signal**: Stack grows until guard trips
- **Fix**: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- **PR**: #1623, branch fix/infinite-recursion-2
- **Outcome**: 54 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

### Occurrence 3: [2026-02-18]
- **Trigger**: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Repro**: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Root cause**: Clock skew between the two hosts
- **Signal**: Stack grows until guard trips
- **Fix**: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- **PR**: #3660, branch fix/infinite-recursion-3
- **Outcome**: p99 latency fell from 8.4 s to 244 ms

### Occurrence 4: [2026-05-13]
- **Trigger**: Sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- **Repro**: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Root cause**: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Signal**: Stack grows until guard trips
- **Fix**: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR**: #5038, branch fix/infinite-recursion-4
- **Outcome**: Memory settled at 421 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

### Occurrence 5: [2026-06-24]
- **Trigger**: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Repro**: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Root cause**: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Signal**: Stack grows until guard trips
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #8496, branch fix/infinite-recursion-6
- **Outcome**: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 91 days running

### Occurrence 6: [2026-07-05]
- **Trigger**: Users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- **Repro**: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Root cause**: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Signal**: Stack grows until guard trips
- **Fix**: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- **PR**: #9728, branch fix/infinite-recursion-7
- **Outcome**: Throughput rose 50 percent, to 929 requests per second

**Context**: All work occurred in the same corner of graph/traversal/walker.rs, so context carried over across fixes."}
